activity_screen.rule_ar: النشاط الأساسي في التمويل التقليدي (البنوك والتمويل والتأمين غير الإسلامي) أو الخمور أو منتجات الخنزير وإنتاج الأغذية غير الحلال وتعبئتها ومعالجتها أو الترفيه (الكازينوهات والقمار والمواد الإباحية) أو التبغ أو تصنيع الأسلحة والدفاع غير متوافق؛ وما عداها يُحتمل فقط في حدود نسبة الدخل غير المتوافق 5% (فحص FTSE Russell الشرعي، تتولاه شركة ياسار).
activity_screen.rule_en: Core activity in conventional finance (non-Islamic banking, finance and insurance), alcohol, pork-related products or non-halal food production, packaging or processing, entertainment (casinos, gambling and pornography), tobacco, or weapons, arms and defence manufacturing is non-compliant; anything else is tolerated only within the 5% non-compliant income ratio (FTSE Russell Shariah screening, undertaken by Yasaar Limited).

basis: FTSE Russell's published Shariah screening criteria (screening undertaken by Yasaar Limited; the FTSE Yasaar Global Equity Shariah Index Series is fatwa-certified by Yasaar's Shariah Supervisory Board): the financial-ratio wording is identical in FTSE Russell's current index factsheets (FTSE Developed Shariah Index factsheet, data as at 30 October 2026) and in the FTSE Yasaar Shariah Supervisory Board Opinion of 3 February 2025. Encoded from FTSE Russell's own published documents, as issue #169's pin gate requires — Kashif's summary of this standard ('debt usually ~30-33%') is explicitly not precise enough and was used only as a cross-check.

documented_conflicts.detail_ar: تصف نشرات FTSE Russell الحالية حد النقد والبنود ذات الفوائد بأنه «أقل من 33.333%»، بينما يصفه رأي مجلس ياسار الشرعي (2025-02-03) بأنه «يجب ألا يتجاوز 33.333%». المعتمد هنا صيغة النشرات الحالية: أقل من (lt).
documented_conflicts.detail_en: FTSE Russell's current factsheets word the cash and interest-bearing items limit as 'less than 33.333%', while the Yasaar Shariah Supervisory Board Opinion (2025-02-03) words the same limit as 'should not exceed 33.333%'. The operative encoding follows the current factsheets: strictly less than (lt). The numeric figure (33.333% of total assets) is identical in both provider documents.
documented_conflicts.item: cash and interest-bearing items comparison wording

name_ar: منهجية مؤشرات FTSE الشرعية — فحص ياسار (FTSE Russell)
name_en: FTSE Shariah Index Series — Yasaar screening (FTSE Russell)
notes: The Ground Rules' tolerance band is index maintenance, not a screening threshold: per the FTSE Shariah Global Equity Index Series Ground Rules (as quoted in the academic literature), a constituent's status changes only after its debt and/or cash ratios remain outside 33.333% +/- 5% for two consecutive quarters. It is not encoded.

Reviews are quarterly. Screening is undertaken by Yasaar Limited and the index series is certified by fatwa of Yasaar's Shariah Supervisory Board, whose scholars represent all the major Shariah schools of thought.

FTSE/Yasaar deliberately measure the ratios against total assets rather than market capitalisation (a 'more conservative approach', per FTSE Russell's factsheet) so a company cannot pass through share-price fluctuation.

capital_component.definition_ar: لا ينشر FTSE/ياسار تطهيرًا للأرباح الرأسمالية؛ التطهير المنشور خاص بالتوزيعات فقط، فلا يُعلن مكوّن رأسمالي.
capital_component.definition_en: FTSE/Yasaar publish dividend purification only; no capital-gains purification is published, so no capital component is declared.

purification.notes_ar: تحسب ياسار نسبة التوزيعات الموزعة المستمدة من دخل الفوائد أو الأنشطة المحظورة وتتيحها للمستخدمين النهائيين ليخصموها من دخل توزيعاتهم ويخرجوها صدقة؛ ولا تُجرى تعديلات التطهير داخل مؤشر العائد الكلي نفسه (الورقة البحثية لمنهجية FTSE الشرعية). لا ينشر FTSE قيمة تطهير للسهم الواحد.
purification.notes_en: Yasaar calculates the percentage of distributed dividends derived from interest income or prohibited activities and makes it available to end users, so investors can deduct that share of their dividend income and give it to charity; dividend cleansing adjustments are not made within the total return index itself (FTSE Shariah methodology white paper). FTSE publishes no per-share purification figure, so per_share_definition is null and no per-share figure is produced.
